body:
CORRECTED RULE (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 18:07Z). This supersedes revision 1, which was WRONG.

DO NOT own-clear an item's named root after its evaluation passes and before `done`.

Evidence, w-339b at 18:02–18:03Z:
- the evaluation (120c29a5) PASSED on gen 1238, source c542f59d;
- the own-clear then made the item's next turn fall back to the MAIN workspace;
- the host recorded that turn as source_changed:true (assumed_missing_baseline, observation 867fb72e);
- the evaluation went stale ("mutation"), so `done` would refuse it.
Tracked as a TermAl recording defect.

Lifecycle now:
1. Keep the root named through evaluation AND `done`.
2. A completed item's root can't be own-cleared, so it stays occupied until w-52222f575b81's audited release lands. That release is the capacity relief.
3. Own-clears remain fine for OPEN parked or ready items that have no pending evaluation. That was today's 26-row cleanup, which was safe.

If an evaluation was staled this way: re-name the SAME worktree root (new generation, same content), then request a fresh evaluation in the next turn.
